messages:
liam: Hey everyone — day 1! A few quick security/setup Qs: 1) MDM installer on my personal Mac fails with 'Profile verification failed'. 2) VPN connects but I can't reach git.redwood.internal (is split-tunnel on/off?). 3) Do I need FileVault on my personal laptop to get dev access? 4) I got a phish-sim invite but no window info. Who do I ping for each?

people-ops: Welcome @liam :tada: — tag the team below depending on the issue (it-support for MDM/VPN, security for phish/KMS, facilities for badge). Also heres the quickstart: https://redwood.example/docs/new-joiner.

it-support: Hi @liam 1: For 'Profile verification failed' try: 1) System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Profiles -> remove old redwood profiles; 2) reboot; 3) reinstall the mobileconfig. If it still fails, dump the enrollment log and paste it here: `log show --predicate 'subsystem CONTAINS "mdm"' --last 1h` (mac). For VPN->git issue: we default to split-tunnel off for devs who need internal repos. If your VPN shows connected but routes missing run `netstat -rn` and paste output. If urgent we can open a temporary jumpbox.

security: Phish-sim: runs for 14 days from invite and sends 2 reminders. Emails come from training@phishsim.io and subject line starts with "Redwood Security Training" 1. FileVault required if device will hold production credentials or access prod infra. For BYOD limited to non-prod, we recommend encryption but can accept a signed BYOD form instead. Contractors need a sponsor + security exception form (rare).

security-bot: Reminder: Security training (SEC101) due in 9 days. Visit https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/sec101 to enroll. Phish-sim FAQ: https://redwood.example/internal/phishsim-faq.

liam: Thanks 1 — quick follow-ups: a) I need read-only access to a test repo for a spike, can that be expedited? b) Any way to test VPN routes without hitting prod assets?

it-support: a) For repo access open a ticket at https://redwood.example/infra/tickets and include manager approval. Mark the ticket "expedite" and include repo path. b) We have a staging jumpbox (staging-jump.redwood.internal) you can use to confirm routes. Try `ssh liam@staging-jump.redwood.internal` after VPN connects.

security: For quick KMS/repo-only needs we often grant ephemeral creds via the Dev Portal: `https://devtools.redwood.internal/ephemeral` (select scope kms:read or repo:read). If you submitted a key-request, paste the request ID here and we can tag it for faster review.

facilities: Badge pickup is available at the lobby between 1-3pm. Bring ID. Reply here if you want us to hold it.

liam: Appreciate it all 1! I removed old profiles and re-ran the installer  worked after a reboot. Filed an infra ticket (REQ-4821) for repo read access and added my manager's approval. I'll test the jumpbox once VPN is stable.

it-support: Got REQ-4821, tagging for expedite. If you still see any VPN route problems paste `netstat -rn` and well take a look.

people-ops: Great! Ping this thread if anything else blocks your first week. Welcome again :slightly_smiling_face:
